name: aqg-test-quality-review
description: Use when reviewing the test-QUALITY of a PR/git diff for BEHAVIOR vs SHAPE assertions, coverage gaps where source changed without paired tests, weakened/deleted/skipped tests, flaky patterns, or anti-horizontal slicing. Review-side validation of already-written tests, deeper than aqg-multi-review's edge_cases slice and complementary to aqg-code-construction's construction-side TDD. Signal only - emits a structured ledger, focus prompts, and `needs_llm_judgement`; the caller runs `/audit` only when `docs/policies/audit-trigger.md` requires external review. Not a test runner, coverage-percentage gate, or replacement for host `/review`.

sentence_patterns: review the test quality of this PR / diff
are these tests actually testing behavior or just the shape of the data structures?
did this diff weaken / delete / skip any tests?
check this PR for flaky tests and coverage gaps
is this test just asserting isinstance instead of real behavior?
run aqg-test-quality-review on my branch diff

cli_contract.0: success — `analyze` printed ledger OR `validate` ledger valid
cli_contract.1: validation failure — `validate` found schema / disposition violations in ledger
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args / unknown subcommand / missing --file
cli_contract.3: reserved — config or schema error (not currently emitted)
cli_contract.70: reserved — internal error placeholder for future use

owner_only_actions: Production, branch protection, and Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates. This skill is read-only: it parses a diff and emits a test-quality ledger plus focus prompts; it never modifies tests/source, never runs the suite, and never calls audit tooling. The caller runs /audit only when docs/policies/audit-trigger.md routes the logical change there.

cases.prompt: review the test quality of this PR — are the tests testing behavior or just the shape of the data?
did this diff weaken, delete, or skip any tests to make CI green?
check this PR for flaky tests and coverage gaps before I merge
this test just asserts isinstance(result, dict) — is it really testing behavior?
run /aqg-test-quality-review analyze on my branch diff and give me the ledger + focus prompts
